method.flow: passages through the entrance plane, (n-1)/(last-first) per run; Student-t 95% over runs
method.flow_ratio: ratio of mean flows model/human; 95% interval exp(log r +- t*se), se^2 = s_m^2/(n_m m_m^2) + s_h^2/(n_h m_h^2), Welch-Satterthwaite df; Fieller interval with the same df; ratio of geometric means with Welch t on log flows
method.flow_ratio_matched: per human run, mean flow of its 5 matched model runs over the human flow; geometric mean of the 5 ratios with a t interval (4 df) on the logs
method.longest_gap: longest time between successive passages per run; geometric mean with a t interval of log values; ratio to humans with Welch t on logs
method.window: 10-90% passage window: obs = passages k=round(0.1(n-1)) to round(0.9(n-1)) of the n observed passages; N = passages ceil(0.1N) to ceil(0.9N) of the N agents, runs not reaching the ceil(0.9N)-th passage excluded; flow = passages/time between them; t interval over runs; ratio as flow_ratio
method.survival: pooled time lapses between successive passages; plain = fraction > t; km = Kaplan-Meier with the final open interval of an incomplete run (last passage to end of run) right-censored; runs_longest = fraction of runs whose longest gap > t (with_final: the final open interval counted as a gap, a lower bound for incomplete runs)
method.completion: k of n runs with every agent through; Wilson 95% interval

runs.start_lineup: lined up directly at the bottleneck

notes.motivation: file code h0 = normal, h1 = hurried, h2 = full commitment (CroMa 2021 dataset page, DOI 10.34735/ped.2021.9; Boomers et al. 2023); at h2 participants lined up directly at the bottleneck, otherwise a 2 m semicircle in front of it was kept clear at the start
notes.corridor: the experiment varied the bottleneck length at two levels, 0.2 m and 2.0 m; the files of the short level carry l021 (0.21 m), i.e. a door in a wall without a corridor behind it
notes.4D040: 136 tracks, 135 passages; track id 35 (marker 717, head height 1.57 m) is followed for 9.3 s and ends 0.16 m before the entrance plane on top of track id 30 (0.005 m apart at its last frame), which then passes; a lost or swapped track at the entrance, not a participant left behind (no track remains in the holding area at the end of the run)
